prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. That said, Kansas City is home to several nationally respected shops across different specialities:

- Barkley — Large, full‑service independent agency known for creative brand and advertising work.
- VML / VMLY&R — Digital‑first global agency with strong capabilities in CX, digital product and integrated campaigns (founded in KC).
- The Integer Group — Strong in shopper/retail marketing and activation, part of a larger network but with KC roots.

Beyond those big names you’ll find many excellent mid‑size and boutique firms that specialize in SEO, paid media, social, PR, B2B demand gen, and web/app development.

How to choose
- Define the outcome you want (brand lift, leads, e‑commerce sales, app installs, PR).
- Look for relevant industry experience and measurable case studies.
- Check client roster, references and independent reviews (Clutch, LinkedIn, local business press).
- Consider culture/communication fit and whether you want a local partner or are comfortable with remote.
- Ask about KPIs, reporting cadence, team assigned to your account and pricing model.

If you tell me what you need (services, budget, industry, timeline), I can shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies that are a good match and explain why.
